awaiting: The six prose strings are still null here, and this is the one language where that is a decision rather than a queue. Kalaallisut is polysynthetic and low-resource: the machine translation that wrote the other forty-one was not good enough here to be worth shipping, and nobody on this side can read it well enough to tell how wrong it is. A null draws the English silently and correctly marked, which is an honest state; a confident wrong sentence is not. It wants a Kalaallisut speaker, and the way to give one this page is /t, as Test-KL-Naatitsisoq.
